scope: Effective user-command perturbations of the five study scenarios (seed 42, no commands otherwise). Never used for training or label selection.
generator: STOP held 5/15/40 steps or one-shot LEFT/FORWARD/RIGHT/DO_NOTHING per train at start fractions 0/0.1/0.25/0.4/0.6/0.8 of the original actor nominal makespan; pairs (STOP 15, LEFT, RIGHT) on two trains; 40 three-command chaos sequences per map.
solvable_rule: The original uc2_demo_ppo actor or DLA completes the same perturbed episode, or deadlock_avoidance/shortest_path/goal_directed/forward_only/60 randomized mixtures complete from the state after the last command (with the original actor). Unsolvable cases are kept for completeness.
